chunks: Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Salamah ibn al-Khaṭṭāb, from ʿAlī ibn Sayf, from ʿAmr ibn Shimr, from Jābir, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
When the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله passed away, the angels, the Muhājirūn, and the Anṣār performed salat upon him, group after group.

He said: And Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام said: I heard the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله saying during his good health and well-being: This verse was only sent down regarding salat upon me after Allah takes me.
Surely Allah and His angels send blessings upon the Prophet. O you who believe, send blessings upon him and submit with a complete submission.

key_terms.الصَّلَاةِ: salat here means invoking blessings upon the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.الْأَنْصَارُ: the Helpers of Madinah among the early believers
key_terms.الْمَلَائِكَةُ: the angels who send blessings upon the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.الْمُهَاجِرُونَ: the Emigrants among the early believers
key_terms.تَسْلِيمًا: complete submission or greeting of peace in full measure
key_terms.قُبِضَ: passed away; literally, his soul was taken

ai.seo_question: How does Qur'an 33:56 relate to sending salat upon the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله after his demise?
ai.summary: This hadith connects the command to send blessings upon the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله with what is to be done after his passing, showing that salat upon him remains an ongoing obligation of reverence. It also depicts the angels and the believing community honoring him at his demise, linking the verse to both devotion and historical practice.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Salma Bin Al Khattab, from Ali Bin Sayf, from Amro Bin Shimr, from Jabir, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘When the Prophetsaww passed away, there Prayed Salat upon himsaww, the Angels, and the Emigrants, and the Helpers, droves and droves’.

Heasws said: ‘And Amir Al-Momineenasws said: ‘Iasws heard Rasool-Allahsaww saying during hissaww good health and hissaww well-being: ‘But rather, this Verse was Revealed unto mesaww regarding the Salat upon mesaww after Allahazwj Captures (mysaww soul)
[33:56] Surely Allah and His Angels are Sending Blessings upon the Prophet; O you who believe! Send blessings upon him and submit to him with a (complete) submission’.
en.sarwar: 38. Certain persons of our people have narrated from in a in a marfu‘ manner have narrated from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Dawud ibn Kathir al-Raqqi who has said that he asked abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) the following.
“What is the meaning of ‘peace be with the Messenger of Allah’?”

The Imam (a.s.) said, “When Allah, the Most Holy, the Most High, created His Prophet, the executor of the will of His Prophet, the daughter of His Prophet, their two sons, all the Imams (a.s.) and their Shi‘a (followers) He made them to form a covenant to exercise patience, help to exercise patience, establish good relations and live piously before Allah. He promised them to give to them the blessed land and sacred sanctuary and to bring down to them the constructed house (al-Bayt al-Ma‘mur) and to manifest to the raised ceiling (alsaqf al-Marfu‘) and grant them relief against their enemies. Also He grant them the earth that He will change with peace and protect all that is therein for them without any quarrels therein against the enemies and there will exist all that they would love. The Messenger of Allah made all the Imams and their Shi‘a to form a covenant similarly.

Offering of peace to him is to remind of that covenant and renew it before Allah. that pehaps He, the Most Majestic, the Most gracious, would allow that peace to take place soon for all of you with all that is therein.”
